records.name: Die With Me
records.tagline: AIM buddy list for your friends’ Claude Code and Codex usage
records.description: An AIM buddy list for your AI usage. See friends’ Claude Code and Codex allowances as little mascots on your Mac. Set a status, visit their rooms, and unlock a chatroom when your allowance runs low. Your AI clocks out, but your friends are still here.

records.name: NovaSynth by Noveum
records.tagline: Test your voice agent on the callers you can’t stage.
records.description: Simulate realistic callers at scale with custom personas, scenarios, interruptions, noise, accents, and network conditions. NovaSynth runs those calls against your voice agent, scores audio and transcripts across 30+ dimensions, and surfaces the failures and fixes that matter to your team.

records.name: CREEM 2.0
records.tagline: Sell and grow your AI built products
records.description: - Creem 2.0 is the money platform for the AI building era: sell software and digital products globally, with payments, taxes, payouts, affiliates and usage billing handled for you - The all in one platform for AI builders to turn what they build into a business. Payments, taxes, billing, affiliates, payouts, worldwide. Building a product went from months to a weekend. Getting paid for it did not, with CREEM you can move at the same speed.

records.name: Zella
records.tagline: Video recorder that edits itself on Mac and iPhone
records.description: Zella records your screen or camera and edits the video for you, on your own Mac or iPhone. Nothing uploads, no account, no subscription. Free at 1080p with no watermark. One tap runs Auto-Polish: captions, silence cuts, filler words removed, zoom-ins and a cleaned-up voice. Make it Viral adds pacing, transitions, sound effects and a music bed. Pro is one payment of $89 that unlocks Mac and iPhone together, for life, instead of a monthly bill.

records.name: AskDeck
records.tagline: Call an AI to get a PowerPoint and a narrated video back
records.description: Every other AI deck tool makes you sit at a laptop and type a prompt. This one you can call. Brief Eric by phone, SMS, email or web — or from inside Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor via MCP. An editable PowerPoint (pptx) and a narrated video that presents it come back. Free watermarked preview: no account, no card. $29 once for the real file, yours to keep, no subscription required. Have a half-done deck? Upload it and Eric finishes it — polish, reskin to your brand, or build it out.

records.name: Opyt
records.tagline: Your attention is the context your AI is missing
records.description: Opyt turns the people and topics you already follow into a knowledge base. Point it at your X bookmarks, Substack subscriptions, blogs, GitHub repos or arXiv papers, and it pulls in their archives. It reads a topic through, writes its own follow-up questions, and keeps looking for new work that builds on what you've collected. Share what your knowledge base, keep exploring, and let your AI read it all. Free, MIT licensed, and your knowledge base can stay local.

records.name: The Forge by Bob's Workshop
records.tagline: Describe your idea & your team builds, deploys & operates it
records.description: The Forge gives you an entire development, sales, and marketing team. Describe what you want to build in plain language. They plan it, design it, build it, and deploy it. No code required. Every app ships with a production quality database and auth system, ai model options, payment integration, built-in CRM, brand management, and autonomous maintenance. Unlike Lovable, Bolt, or Replit — The Forge doesn't just generate code. It operates your product and builds your business.

records.name: MacSentinel
records.tagline: Find what’s slowing your Mac then clean it safely
records.description: MacSentinel brings Mac monitoring, diagnosis, storage analysis, and cleanup into one native workflow. Instead of simply showing system metrics or deleting generic caches, it explains likely causes of slowdowns locally, then helps you act safely. Smart Care includes 500+ app rules across 50 categories, covering developer, creative, productivity, and AI tools. Cleanup is Trash-first and recoverable, and Pro is a one-time purchase — no subscription.

records.name: Pitchfire for Startups
records.tagline: Reach investors that are aligned with you
records.description: Pitchfire for Startups is a new channel to reach investors. Upload your pitch deck, get matched to VCs with our AI, and let Pitchfire hype your startup with an email intro. Pitchfire brings investors and startups togethr. Over the past year, we've built AI associates for VC firms, and are now inverting the tech to match startups up with VCs. Sign up to get matched and intro'd to three investors a day. Upload your investor lists and we'll intro you if we have their contact data.

records.name: Blanc
records.tagline: A minimal browser with a floating island for a toolbar
records.description: Blanc is a free desktop browser for macOS, Windows and Linux. Its floating Island replaces the tab strip and toolbar, while ad and tracker blocking runs at the network layer. Optional Patron adds Named Workspaces.

records.name: Figo
records.tagline: See every move your competitors make
records.description: Figo watches your competitors so you do not have to. Every week it checks their rankings, new pages, blog posts, Google Ads, Meta ads, TikTok ads, Instagram, Facebook and Reddit, plus what ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Perplexity say when buyers ask for a recommendation. Monday morning you get a short briefing: what changed, what it means, and one thing to do about it. Add your website and it finds the competitors for you.

records.name: Higgsfield API
records.tagline: One async API for 50+ generative media models
records.description: Higgsfield API is one authenticated, asynchronous API for generative media. Call Seedance, Kling, Soul, Grok Imagine, Wan, and 50+ frontier models through the same request lifecycle — submit, poll or webhook, download. Explore models in Console, get keys in Cloud, ship with Python/TypeScript SDKs. Pay per use with intro discounts up to 50% off your top models. Build your own Higgsfield at open.higgsfield.ai.

records.name: Modaal for Android
records.tagline: Ship on both stores from one project using Swift + Kotlin
records.description: Modaal for Android let you ship one app to both stores with your own AI agent - no rebuild. Rather than one React Native codebase that draws the same screens on both phones, Modaal shares the logic, not the screens: your agent writes real Swift/SwiftUI for iPhone and real Kotlin and Jetpack Compose for Android from one project, and the build proves both behave the same. So anyone who built an iPhone app with Modaal can add Android without touching a line of logic — no credit meters, no rebuild.

records.name: Text Agent Store
records.tagline: A marketplace for AI agents you can text
records.description: Meet all the agents you can text. Agent Store is a directory of AI agents that live inside a contact in your phone book. Browse an ecosystem of texting agents, and send one text to start using them today. No account, no download, no setup.

records.name: Bitrise Remote Dev Environments
records.tagline: Cloud Macs your coding agents can actually build on
records.description: Bitrise RDE gives you cloud Macs & Linux machines that start in seconds, the same machines, stacks and caches as your CI. Give every agent its machine and run them in parallel via MCP, or attach VS Code, Cursor or Claude Code. Archive when you stop, restore later.

records.name: Portal
records.tagline: Links to try any product at any moment with no setup
records.description: Portal gives you a cloud computer you can set up to show off a signed in account, and gives you a link. Whoever opens it is inside - no signup, no install. Choose what's off limits, make it multi-player or for async use, and add an optional AI that can see the screen and run full customer conversations, then share it like a Google Doc.

records.name: QuietHint®
records.tagline: The meeting assistant that stays on your Mac
records.description: QuietHint listens to your call on your Mac and suggests a short reply while a question is still being asked. No bot joins the meeting and audio never leaves your device: speech is transcribed on the Mac, with your words kept apart from theirs. Hints land in a small overlay during the call, not in a summary afterwards. Works with any call app, uses your own Anthropic key, free to try on Apple silicon.

records.name: Amy by Jellyfish
records.tagline: Your AI sourcing employee for recruiting teams
records.description: Amy an AI sourcer for recruiting agencies. She learns what a company needs, searches across LinkedIn, GitHub, Google Scholar, and anywhere else on the web for people who may be a good fit, and explains why. She sends personalized messages, follows up, handles replies, and sends interested, qualified candidates to the recruiter.

records.name: S-Roll
records.tagline: An agentic harness that turns long videos into clips
records.description: S-Roll is a fully local agentic harness for video understanding. Open a podcast, gameplay recording, interview, or talk and describe the moment you want. S-Roll finds the footage, creates clips, suggests highlights, tracks subjects, and provides an editor for trimming, reframing, captions, titles, and export. All AI processing runs on your Mac, so videos, transcripts, and chats stay there. Free on the Mac App Store with no watermark.

records.name: Ever Beyond: Space Conquest
records.tagline: Tactical Battles & Idle Merge
records.description: Ever Beyond is a brand new take on idle/incremental games with merge-based gameplay and old-school C&C-style intense RTS tactical battles. Build, merge, upgrade, research, explore, and conquer planets, solar systems, and even entire galaxies. Immense depth with minigames, expeditions, and deep tactical combat. Play battles hands-on or let them run idle. Fully playable offline, with the whole game accessible without excessive wait timers or paywalled systems.

records.name: NavKey
records.tagline: Control Windows with only your keyboard
records.description: NavKey is a way to control Windows with only your keyboard. Click buttons, scroll, right-click, switch apps and navigate your PC without constantly reaching for the mouse.

records.name: Analytiics
records.tagline: Web and product analytics, set up by your coding agent
records.description: Web and product analytics, set up by your coding agent. Your tracking plan lives in your repo and powers typed events, charts, funnels and CI checks. Understand visitors and revenue, measure anonymous traffic without cookies, and start free.

records.name: MCPJam
records.tagline: The testing & evaluations platform for MCP servers
records.description: Run User Testing, Swarms, Evals, and CI/CD gates on your MCP server to see if users actually succeed in ChatGPT, Claude, and Copilot. Test local servers via desktop app, CLI, or SDK.

records.name: QAgent
records.tagline: Automated QA for AI agents. Stop shipping on vibes.
records.description: Automate AI agent quality testing. Score correctness, detect hallucinations against ground truth, verify policy adherence, and benchmark RAG before bad responses reach real customers.

records.name: Axiom
records.tagline: The modern machine data platform
records.description: The modern machine data platform — Petabyte-scale, schema-less ingest on a fully managed event store, so you keep every byte without the operational cost of running it yourself.

records.name: Compute:Arena
records.tagline: Community submitted benchmarks for Local AI
records.description: Community-submitted performance benchmarks for local AI models on any hardware, any runtime, any quantisation.

records.name: worldsplat
records.tagline: Turn 3D sketches into worlds
records.description: We allow users to sketch out their vision in 3D before generating, so instead of worrying about the little details you can focus on bringing your world to life.

records.name: TinyKPI
records.tagline: Your business analytics directly in your notch
records.description: Connect the tools you already usefrom Stripe and PostHog to Google Analytics and your own database. Pick the KPIs you care about, arrange them your way, and keep them live in a tiny, customizable dashboard built around your MacBook notch. 100% local. Your data never leaves your Mac.

records.name: EZLink
records.tagline: One link for everything you make
records.description: A fast, free link-in-bio page for creators. Claim your username, add your links, and share one address everywhere. Free analytics, no forced branding.

records.name: Would You For Cash?
records.tagline: Party cards that ask how far you’d go for the right price
records.description: A party card game for iPhone. Draw money hypotheticals, swipe yes or no, then argue about why. Free Classic deck. Premium decks are one-time unlocks — no ads, no account, no tracking. 17+.

records.name: Video Download Assistant
records.tagline: Download video, audio, HLS and images from webpages
records.description: Video Download Assistant is a browser extension for Chrome and Edge that detects downloadable media on the page you’re viewing. It supports direct video and audio files, HLS/m3u8 and DASH streams, live stream recording, images, download queues, and browser-based remuxing or conversion. Choose the resource and quality you want, then save it with a few clicks.

records.name: Fresh Air: Focus Pomodoro
records.tagline: Calm doodle pomodoro with companions you unlock by focusing
records.description: Fresh Air is a calm visual pomodoro for people who struggle to start: one clear task, Focus → short rest → repeat, and doodle companions that keep you company. What’s different: paper-and-ink UI (not another cold dashboard), gems from focused minutes to unlock Friends, soft Progress charts, gentle nature sounds, plus widgets & Live Activities so your session stays nearby. Free forever for unlimited focus. Pro unlocks more sounds, custom breaks & rounds, every companion, and backup

records.name: ApexGrid UI
records.tagline: React 19 & Tailwind CSS Dashboard Suites for Startups
records.description: ApexGrid is an elite software asset studio delivering production-ready, high-fidelity frontend dashboard suites for funded SaaS startups and enterprise tech agencies. We specialize in modular, clean-coded React and Tailwind architecture, engineered to save engineering teams 40+ hours of design and development setup time.

records.name: 120+ Free Web Tools
records.tagline: Discover, Compare, Create & Connect in One Place
records.description: Axevora is evolving beyond a collection of online tools into an all-in-one discovery platform. Explore useful AI and web tools, discover and compare products, find shopping opportunities, join Community Boards, share ideas, ask questions, play games, and discover resources for work and everyday life. Built around one simple idea: make useful things easier to discover, compare, and use — all in one place.

records.name: knowhere
records.tagline: Year 12 study built for your brain, not the textbook
records.description: Every Year 12 (HSC & VCE) concept rebuilt for how a student actually thinks: 9 motivational types, a neurology layer for ADHD, ASD and dyslexia, 4 modes. 866 interactive concepts, 31 subjects, every one on every plan. 7 days free. Built solo in Australia.

records.name: Fundering.help
records.tagline: Foundation risk insights for every Dutch home
records.description: Fundering.help helps homeowners and buyers understand the foundation risk of any home in the Netherlands. Enter an address to explore local risks, view foundation data on an interactive map, and get a personalized foundation assessment. We turn complex data into a clear risk indication and practical next steps, helping you spot potential foundation problems before they become expensive.

records.name: Meridia Languages
records.tagline: Learn a language by exploring a cozy 3D world
records.description: Immersive language learning through interactions in a 3D world for all ages. Explore beatiful 3D environments, tap objects to hear their names, and put words and phrases to use in short activities. Earn stars and unlock new places as you learn. Built for beginners who want language practice to feel more like discovery. Available on iPhone. Free to start, with a Premium subscription for more content.

records.name: Aithos Agent Cards
records.tagline: Host your A2A Agent Cards on Aithos
records.description: Publish signed A2A Agent Cards to a public registry via API. Verify associated domains with DNS TXT records. Free to use; design partners welcome.

records.name: Rumo
records.tagline: Self-hosted video meetings without accounts or subscriptions
records.description: Rumo is a free, self-hosted video meeting platform built for people who want to run their own meetings. No accounts or per-seat pricing. It supports guest-based rooms, WebRTC video, screen sharing, chat, recording, breakout rooms, polls, whiteboards, host controls, custom branding, and embeddable meetings.

records.name: LAIGEND
records.tagline: Find businesses. Discover what to sell them faster.
records.description: LAIGEND turns business discovery into sales opportunity intelligence. Instead of another list of leads, it analyzes each business and identifies what service is most worth selling first — Website, Messaging/WhatsApp Automation, AI Receptionist/Voice Agent, or CRM/Lead Follow-Up. Businesses are scored and prioritized so freelancers, agencies and service providers can focus on the right prospects with the right offer. Try 30 business analyses free — no card required.

records.name: ShapeSync
records.tagline: Nutrition, Training, Sleep
records.description: ShapeSync reads Apple Health data from any app you use for tracking and turns it into a dashboard that explains what's happening with your weight. New since launch: an AI Coach giving active, dosage-level recommendations based on your real data — not generic tips. Plus real plateau detection with trend smoothing + goal-date projection, and Watch calorie-burn calibration. Metrics stay on your iPhone — no account, no cloud. Only AI Coach queries are sent, with consent, to power the analysis.

records.name: A Better COD form for Shopify!
records.tagline: The COD form built to convert — not just to collect.
records.description: Hey Product Hunt 👋 I'm Mo, CRO expert & UX designer. After years optimizing checkout flows for 7–8 figure DTC brands, I kept seeing the same issue: COD forms built by developers, not conversion experts. So I built Better COD — an all-in-one Shopify COD funnel with forms, upsells, quantity breaks, and templates. No app stacking. → CRO-focused UX → Popup or embedded → Ready-made templates → 100% free, no limits We're just getting started and would love honest feedback from COD merchants!

records.name: Glypdl
records.tagline: Open-source media downloader for Linux, Windows & Android
records.description: Glypdl is a free and open-source native media downloader powered by yt-dlp and FFmpeg. Download video and audio from supported websites with native apps for Linux, Windows, and Android. It supports playlists, multiple formats, thumbnails, progress tracking, and more—all through a simple graphical interface.

records.name: Aphex CMS
records.tagline: Aphex is a fully open source CMS built on SvelteKit
records.description: Aphex is a fully open source CMS built on SvelteKit. One codebase, one deploy, with content stored in your own database. Developers get schema-as-code and typed APIs. Editors get a polished Studio.

records.name: Caramel Lab
records.tagline: AI research workspace from idea to peer review
records.description: Caramel Lab is an AI research workspace that connects research ideation, KCI/OpenAlex literature discovery, PDF analysis and academic translation, report and manuscript drafting, figure generation, AI editing, simulated peer review, and reusable research memory. It is designed to reduce context switching across the research workflow. Researchers should verify important claims, numbers, and citations against original sources.

records.name: Speech Coach
records.tagline: AI coaching for becoming a better speaker.
records.description: Speech Coach is an AI-powered speaking practice app that helps students become clearer, more confident speakers. Give a short speech, get instant AI feedback on pace, filler words, confidence, emphasis and more, then practice your weak spots with targeted challenges and daily workouts. No audience needed. Just speak, get coached, and improve — one rep at a time.

records.name: Ai-Guide
records.tagline: Give AI coding agents a map of your codebase.
records.description: AI Guide is a privacy-first, deterministic code intelligence layer that helps AI coding agents and developers understand and navigate software repositories. It analyzes source code and builds a Unified Graph of files, symbols, and relationships, with exact source locations. V1 supports Python, TypeScript/TSX, JavaScript/JSX, C++, and Java.

records.name: Reference Draft
records.tagline: design discovery and community platform
records.description: Reference Draft is a community and design discovery platform created specifically for designers. It serves as a hub for finding creative inspiration, exploring new design assets, and sharing professional workflows.

records.name: Worthtally
records.tagline: Net worth on every device, with no bank login, ever
records.description: Worthtally is a private, local-first net-worth tracker for cash, savings, investments, crypto, property and debt, one clear number, trends, budgets, goals and planners. Your data stays on your device. No account, no cloud.

records.name: nobg
records.tagline: Free, open-source background remover in your browser
records.description: A free, open-source background remover that runs entirely in your browser. Nothing gets uploaded, and of course an amazing UX.

records.name: Sachiri Pipeline
records.tagline: Quote-to-cash for small businesses
records.description: Sachiri Pipeline is a lightweight sales pipeline built for small businesses, not enterprises. Track leads, send quotations customers can accept with a single link (no login), then invoice and track Paid/Unpaid/Partial yourself. Built after years implementing Dynamics 365 for teams that needed 10% of it and none of the per-seat pricing. Free tier is permanent, no trial countdown, no bait-and-switch. Still pre-revenue and looking for early feedback.

records.name: Puffdoro
records.tagline: Tactile 3D silicone focus pet & gentle Pomodoro companion
records.description: Puffdoro combines a real-time WebGL silicone fidget toy with a calm, buzzer-free Pomodoro companion right inside your browser toolbar. Real-time mass-spring deformation physics, procedural ambient Web Audio soundscapes, 100% digital with zero physical shipping, and zero tracking.

records.name: DelbarMe. Find your people
records.tagline: A voice-first community for Afghans in the diaspora
records.description: DelbarMe is a voice-first community for Afghans in the diaspora. Discover people, join Halqas around shared interests, explore events, share posts and photos, and connect through voice. Create a profile with a voice introduction and start meaningful conversations with people around the world. Built to bring Afghan communities, interests and conversations together in one modern space.

records.name: NutriLife
records.tagline: NutriLife — Tes repas réglés. Ta vie allégée.
records.description: NutriLife réunit dans une seule application tout ce qu’il faut pour mieux manger sans alourdir son quotidien : planification personnalisée des repas, plus de 1 000 recettes, liste de courses automatique, scanner de produits et suivi des calories, macronutriments, du poids et du budget. Contrairement aux applications centrées sur le comptage, NutriLife réduit surtout la charge mentale liée aux repas et aux courses.

records.name: Foyer Picks
records.tagline: AI movie picks based on your mood
records.description: Foyer Picks helps you find what to watch based on your mood, preferences, and constraints. Pick a mood, filter by genre, rating, or streaming platform, or describe what you want in plain English. AI then recommends movies and series and explains why each pick fits. It combines mood-based discovery, natural-language preferences, and personalized AI recommendations to make choosing what to watch faster and easier.

records.name: Code Tracker AI
records.tagline: AI-powered code intelligence for JetBrains IDEs
records.description: Code Tracker AI brings real-time code intelligence, explainability, and developer clarity directly into JetBrains IDEs. It analyzes your code, flags issues, explains root causes, and preserves your reasoning with automatic Code Books. Unlike traditional linters, CTAI teaches while it fixes — helping developers ship faster, onboard quicker, and maintain long-term project clarity.

records.name: AyniCam
records.tagline: Turn your iPhone into an AI driving co-pilot
records.description: AyniCam turns your iPhone into an AI-powered driving companion. It combines on-device object detection, segmentation, incident recording, parking assistance, Virtual View, navigation and 3D maps in one app. AI processing runs locally with Core ML for fast, privacy-focused road awareness.

records.name: Runners Lab
records.tagline: Every calculation a runner needs.
records.description: Free running calculators for pace, races, training volume, performance, track, treadmill, cadence, hills, energy, fueling, conditions, weather, and fun tools. No signup. Exact math where it is exact; published models where it is an estimate.

records.name: Reimagine
records.tagline: Roleplay a conversation with someone you write yourself
records.description: There's a conversation you keep replaying. Reimagine lets you play it out again — with someone you wrote yourself. Build a Persona for how you like to be spoken to, then write the other side: a parent, a manager, a friend you drifted from. Their name, their role, how they speak, what they remember. No catalogue, no pre-made characters. Five free messages and five new conversations a day. No subscription.

records.name: Cards of Spice - Adult Couples Card Game
records.tagline: Spark meaningful moment with your partner one card at a time
records.description: Cards of Spice is a browser-based card game designed for adult couples looking to deepen intimacy and connection. Built on modern web tech (Next.js), it features a dynamic task system that generates fresh scenarios and challenges every time you play—no two games are alike. Whether you're looking to break the ice, laugh together, or explore a deeper level of connection, Cards of Spice delivers an experience that's playful, engaging, and genuinely useful. Play anytime, anywhere, on any device.

records.name: Lynxview
records.tagline: Minimalist and Lightweight image viewer for Mac
records.description: Browse and view images across your folders with ease. Navigate through images in any directory, quickly jumping between files with an intuitive thumbnail strip. View detailed information about each image including dimensions, file size, and format. Key Features: - Browse images in folders and navigate with thumbnail previews - View image metadata like dimensions, file size, and format - Support for 15+ image formats including PSD and Photoshop documents - Dark or Light mode support

records.name: thisweek
records.tagline: Turn your meal plan into a grocery list
records.description: Paste a recipe link and thisweek pulls the ingredients, organizes them by grocery section, and merges them into one shopping list. Use it without logging in, or sign in to share the list and shop together with family and friends.

records.name: Simple PO Tracker
records.tagline: Purchase order tracking made simple, built for small teams.
records.description: SimplePOTracker was built by an industry operator who lived the PO tracking pain firsthand, not a software company guessing at features. Every feature is built through the lens of the actual user, focused only on what businesses need day-to-day, with none of the bloat that makes ERPs and complex tools hard to adopt. No steep learning curve, no unnecessary complexity. Start free, or unlock unlimited users on Pro for just $49/month. Simple pricing to match simple software.

records.name: SoundLatch
records.tagline: Help keep Bluetooth speakers awake between sounds
records.description: SoundLatch sends a user-started audio stream during quiet periods to help compatible speakers, soundbars and other Android audio outputs avoid idle standby. Test signal modes, save device profiles, and control sessions from Android, Android TV and Google TV.

records.name: Gram App
records.tagline: Gram is a food delivery and meal subscription app
records.description: Gram is a food delivery and meal subscription app designed to make everyday eating simple, affordable, and convenient. From fresh, home-style monthly meal plans to healthy everyday meals, Gram connects you with trusted local kitchens and food providers nearby.

records.name: Claudescope
records.tagline: One local viewer for all your AI coding-agent sessions
records.description: Your coding agents record everything – prompts, tool calls, diffs, costs – but none of it is readable. Claude Code writes JSONL, opencode uses SQLite, every agent differs. Claudescope indexes them all locally into one interface: full-text search across every session, a readable view with syntax-highlighted diffs, a files-changed tab, and cost analytics by project, model and agent. Claude Code, Codex, opencode, Copilot CLI, Junie, pi, Antigravity. Localhost only, no telemetry. MIT.

records.name: PDF Tools Club
records.tagline: Private PDF tools. No uploads, no signup.
records.description: 33 free PDF tools that process documents locally in your browser. Merge, split, fill forms, annotate and run English OCR. Build an Application Pack with clickable contents and page numbers, or split a PDF into measured-size parts for upload limits. No account or document uploads.

records.name: Tegrona Lite
records.tagline: Plan a solar panel layout from one photo of the roof
records.description: Outline the roof on a photo — a drone shot, or one taken from the ground. Tegrona Lite removes the perspective by reading the tile pattern, so trapezoid and triangular roof sections work too. It takes the scale from the tile size, fills the roof with panels, and exports an A4 spec sheet for the customer. Free, no account. The web version runs entirely in your browser with nothing uploaded; native apps for macOS, Windows, iPad and Android.

records.name: Whaat
records.tagline: WhatsApp in your language
records.description: Whaat is an automatic translation tool built directly into WhatsApp. It enables real-time, multi-language communication in the same chat window without switching apps or forcing the other person to install anything.

records.name: CarbonSight
records.tagline: Visualizing your path to net-zero
records.description: CarbonSight is the first offline-first food carbon footprint tracker built for regions where connectivity can't be assumed. It lets users check a product's contents and carbon impact before they eat it — no constant internet required, unlike existing carbon apps.

records.name: Local Whisper
records.tagline: Private dictation that never leaves your PC
records.description: Local Whisper is offline voice-to-text for Windows. Hold a hotkey, speak into any app — email, docs, Slack, code, or an AI prompt — and clean, punctuated text lands right where your cursor is. The speech engine runs entirely on your PC, so nothing is uploaded and no account is needed. It works with no internet, even in airplane mode. Your voice never leaves your machine. And it's a one-time purchase — no subscription, ever.

records.name: TransLocale
records.tagline: AI app localization for developers and coding agents
records.description: Translate your app with AI that uses your product’s tone, glossary, and message notes. Review wording, catch missing keys and broken placeholders, then deliver approved updates to web and mobile apps. Work in the dashboard, CLI, REST API, or your AI assistant through MCP. Supports Next.js, React, Vue, Nuxt, SvelteKit, and Flutter. Start with 10,000 free characters each month and set a usage cap before translating.

records.name: Pixly.gg
records.tagline: Not playing 24/7? Get a bigger Minecraft server for less
records.description: Minecraft server hosting with no subscription: pay for the time your server is online, metered by the minute from a prepaid balance, from $0.07/hr. Each server has its own machine, nothing shared. It sleeps when the last player leaves (no hourly charge while asleep, just a small storage fee) and wakes in 15-30 s when someone joins. One switch for Java + Bedrock crossplay, one for proximity voice. Modrinth and CurseForge mods and modpacks in one search. About 10 hours to try, no card needed.

records.name: ClusterSwipe
records.tagline: 100% Private library decluttering - no sub!
records.description: You know when you take 5 pictures of the same thing and never delete the 4 worst ones? ClusterSwipe lets you find similar pictures and finds the best one to keep so you can regain a lot of space on your phone in just a few taps. ClusterSwipe keeps your photo library 100% private uses on-device computer vision to compare and rate your photos, so you can save time and space.

records.name: PhotoFlow — Screenshot Workflow
records.tagline: The Central Hub for QA Screenshots
records.description: PhotoFlow — Screenshot workflow tracker for makers, QA and engineering teams. PhotoFlowHQ is a central hub for QA screenshots. records.name: TabMail 1.8
records.tagline: Now open source. AI email for Thunderbird and iPhone.
records.description: TabMail 1.8 is now open source, with better UX and improved AI quality. Auto replies, email triage, conversational editing, and chat with your inbox. On Thunderbird or iPhone. Supercharge your existing inbox with AI.

records.name: POZ
records.tagline: AI,Community
records.description: Discover what is happening and join the conversation on POZ. Trending stories, fresh perspectives, and everyday finds from people and clearly labeled AI residents.

records.name: GLITCH-FX
records.tagline: Glitch art editor with 30+ stackable effects.
records.description: GLITCH-FX is a browser-based glitch art editor. Drop in an image, stack 30+ effects — pixel sort, datamosh, RGB shift, VHS tracking, scanlines, dot matrix, duotone — and drag to reorder the pipeline. Everything re-renders live. Export a still, or animate your stack into a GIF. Save presets as JSON, or share a link so others can load your exact settings. No upload, no signup, no watermark. All processing happens on your device — your images never leave the browser.

records.name: Pombo
records.tagline: The MCP-native lifecycle marketing platform
records.description: Pombo is the email platform your agent runs. Connect ChatGPT, Claude, or Cursor and it sets up your account, migrates your contacts, templates, and campaigns from your current tool, and designs your sequences. Or just describe a goal and let it draft the marketing for you. Marketing, lifecycle, and transactional email, all from the same platform. Free forever up to 1,000 contacts, no card required.

records.name: Universal Select
records.tagline: Unlock copy, paste & right-click with a smart context menu.
records.description: Hate websites that block right-click, stop text selection, or disable pasting? Universal Select restores your browser freedom while packing a full productivity suite: • Smart Context Menu: Dark/light menu with link & page navigation • Typing Simulation: "Paste as Typed" for blocked form fields • Text Expander: Expand shortcuts (:email, :sig) anywhere • In-Page Clipboard History (Ctrl+Shift+H) • 1-Click Overlay & Paywall Backdrop Zapper 100% private, zero telemetry, local-first.

records.name: Stampzo
records.tagline: Digital stamp cards for local shops
records.description: Stampzo replaces paper punch cards with a QR digital stamp card for cafes, salons, gyms and kirana shops in India. Customers scan one QR to join — no app store download — and keep the card on their phone. Staff stamp visits from any phone; no extra hardware. Shops get a print-ready QR kit, a visits and rewards dashboard, and clear pricing in rupees. First program is free. Built for one shop, one offer, one reward — not a multi-brand points mall.

records.name: IntelliLogic  Ai
records.tagline: AI Operating System for Medical Device Distribution
records.description: IntelliLogic is the AI operating system for medical device distribution. 10 integrated modules unify surgical case management, tray and consignment inventory, digital chargesheets, rep commissions, OR scheduling and real-time analytics. Reps capture cases offline in the OR. HIPAA-ready with BAA. Start a 14-day free trial.

records.name: FuelFalcon
records.tagline: Compare fuel prices and track your favourite stations
records.description: Find and compare fuel prices in Australia and the UK. Search by area or postcode, explore stations on a map, view price history and save stations to your Fuel Watchlist.

records.name: Swappr
records.tagline: All-in-one AI creator studio to build virtual influencer
records.description: All-in-one AI creator studio to build a consistent virtual influencer, generate images and videos, publish across social platforms, and monetize content.

records.name: Scry
records.tagline: Search inside your screenshots, and never share one blind.
records.description: Scry reads every screenshot on your Mac, so you can search the words inside them months later. It also looks before you share: drag out a shot holding a card number or a private photo and it turns red and says so. All on device. No account, no server.

records.name: Feather: open source Fey alternative
records.tagline: US equity research mac app, free, open source and 100% local
records.description: Fey shut down after its acquisition, so I built an open source alternative. Feather is a desktop app for US equity research: live quotes, natural language screener, morning briefs, earnings calendar, watchlists. Runs with zero API keys on mock data.

records.name: slopXiv
records.tagline: preprint server for ai papers
records.description: An open-access index of research with substantial AI contributions, with source links, available provenance and a graded measure of human involvement.

records.name: ReplyDuck
records.tagline: Get your product recommended on Reddit
records.description: ReplyDuck monitors Reddit for conversations where your product is a genuine fit, scores every thread 0-100 by buying intent, and drafts a helpful, native-sounding reply in your own writing style. You review and post from your own account: no bots, no auto-posting, no banned accounts.

records.name: after5.pm
records.tagline: Go out, meet new people, no pressure!
records.description: After5.pm turns nearby evening plans into small-group events with new people. Find something happening after 5 PM, see who’s joining, claim a spot, and meet in real life. Join a happy hour, dinner, trivia night, live show, pickleball game, gallery visit, or whatever sounds good—or host a plan of your own in minutes.

records.name: OptiMeasure
records.tagline: Turn your iPhone into an optical measurement toolkit
records.description: Measure PD, monocular PD, near PD and advanced eyewear fitting parameters using your iPhone — with professional tools for opticians.

records.name: Filum AI
records.tagline: AI-native Customer platform for Sales, Support & CX
records.description: Filum brings WhatsApp, Zalo, Messenger, Shopee and Email into a single inbox where an AI Agent works around the clock - replying instantly, closing orders overnight, opening tickets, and hand off to your team on their own. Free trial available.

records.name: UCD Ads Network
records.tagline: Promote your business. Monetize your website.
records.description: Built for small businesses that struggle to advertise outside of Instagram and TikTok. Launch an ad campaign in a few minutes, or add one snippet of code to your site and start earning automatically. No subscription, no bidding system to learn. Just a simple way to get seen, or turn your website traffic into something more. Every ad is personally reviewed before it goes live.

records.name: Bitrovo: Bitrix Panel
records.tagline: Manage Bitrix servers in a browser, not an SSH menu
records.description: Bitrix servers are often managed via an SSH menu. Hosting panels tend to rewrite nginx and take over port 443 — risky on production. Bitrovo is a free web panel for Bitrix / Bitrix24 servers: sites, PHP, databases, services, disk, crontab, and support. It installs next to live sites, not on top of them. Signed releases, dry-run install, rollback on failure. If 443 is busy, it uses its own HTTPS port.

records.name: Münzwurf
records.tagline: Kostenloser Online-Münzwurf für schnelle Entscheidungen
records.description: Kopf oder Zahl is a free, no-signup online coin flip tool for quick everyday decisions. Click once and get an instant result — heads or tails, in seconds. Unlike most coin flip tools, this one is minimal, fast-loading, and distraction-free — no ads, no account, no unnecessary steps. Just open the site and flip. Perfect for settling debates, making quick choices, or having fun with friends.
